title: Colonists
summary: Your colonists are people: they live, work, have opinions of you, and can be lost.
text:
Each colonist has a name, a family line, a specialty, a few traits and a story. Tap one walking about (or find them in the Colony panel) to see their card: how they feel, what they think of you, where they live and work, who they love.

They look after themselves: they find a home, take a job (specialists go to matching buildings first), walk to work during shift hours and home after. When predators come near, everyone runs for the nearest building.

The **👤** readout counts colonists (+ any growing in pods). Tap it for the **Colony panel**: the colony's mood, its policies, everyone by name, the cryo bank and the memorial.

Unlike drones and turrets, people can't be rebuilt.
